findings.title: Bundle attribution reports UTF-16 columns as built bytes
findings.what: attributeChunk() subtracts JavaScript string indices and calls the result bytes, although those indices are UTF-16 code units. Any emitted non-ASCII character makes group totals differ from the on-disk UTF-8 byte totals reported by statSync(), so bundle-size recommendations are not reproducible as byte claims.
findings.fix: Attribute each mapped span with Buffer.byteLength(line.slice(startColumn, endColumn), 'utf8'), including the actual newline only when present, rather than using column subtraction.
findings.acceptance: A fixture chunk containing a multibyte UTF-8 character attributes its exact Buffer.byteLength to the mapped source, and all attributed spans sum to the chunk byte length.
findings.verifyNote: Second-pass reread of baseline lines 69-97 confirmed readFileSync(..., 'utf8'), string-length arithmetic at lines 71, 88, and 96, while the report labels totals as built bytes.

findings.title: Atomizer permits output-root path traversal through mapping and rules-dir
findings.what: The CLI accepts --section subtree values, JSON map values, and --rules-dir components without rejecting '..'. normalizeSubtree() preserves traversal segments and join(outRoot, move.rulePathRel) then resolves them outside outRoot before mkdirSync/writeFileSync. A supplied mapping subtree such as ../../target with --emit agents-md, or --rules-dir ../../target, therefore writes outside the declared clone/config output root.
findings.fix: Validate every generated rule path after resolve(outRoot, rulePathRel) and reject it unless it is strictly contained by outRoot; reject absolute paths and traversal components in rulesDirRel and mapping subtrees before planning.
findings.acceptance: Non-dry-run invocations using --rules-dir ../../escape or --section x=../../escape fail before creating any external file, while valid nested relative targets still write beneath outRoot.
findings.verifyNote: Second-pass reread confirmed traversal segments survive normalization at lines 293-295, CLI inputs are accepted at lines 781-794, and lines 562-572 write the joined path without the containment check used by revertFile at lines 641-648.
